}}'''Reed Soalen''' is a [[Two Rivers]] man following [[Perrin Aybara]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Reed Soalen}}

== Activities ==
Reed is part of Perrin Aybara's army. He now has turns with the other [[Two Rivers]] men by being Perrin's bodyguard. He is on guard duty at the [[Field of Merrilor]] when he meets [[Rand]] with Perrin.

==Trivia==
Reed Soalen is named for Scott Reid, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
